newsitem.title: FRANCE: Released French hostage in Yewmen seized again.
newsitem.headline: Released French hostage in Yewmen seized again.

text.p: Yemeni tribesmen have retaken a French diplomat they had released hours earlier, French Foreign Ministry sources said on Sunday.
They said the diplomat and mediators accompanying him were abducted on Saturday night as they were returning to the capital Sanaa from the northern region where he had been held for six days.

"The (French) embassy informed us that the French diplomat whose release was announced last night was seized again with his Yemeni escort by the same tribesmen as they were returning to Sanaa," a ministry spokesman said.
The al-Toaiman tribesmen had released their hostage to three prominent tribal chiefs who were mediating on behalf of the government, according to Yemeni officials.
The Toaiman tribe was demanding more jobs, settlement of a land dispute and government compensation for losses to homes, farms, water pumps and wells by floods that killed 65 people last June.
Several diplomats, foreigners and tourists have been kidnapped in Yemen in recent years by tribesmen with mostly non-political grievances against the government.
